title: Method and system for detecting typical object of transmission line based on unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) federated learning

pse.problem: Inefficient detection of transmission line objects due to congested communication links in conventional UAV-based methods
pse.solution_function: Federated learning based method for training and updating a YOLOv3 object detection model on distributed UAVs for detecting insulators, wires, or pins of a transmission line
pse.solution_structure: A network of UAVs divided into multiple federated learning units, each with access to local data of transmission line objects and a Horovod and FATE federated learning framework
pse.solution_implementation: Training process involves using a prior database of transmission line object images and tags to create a detection model. Federated learning updates the model locally on each UAV without centralized data upload, reducing communication congestion.
pse.effect: Improved detection efficiency for transmission line objects by minimizing communication delays and bandwidth usage
